narrative: checks/a733-thermal-clock-reference.c (removed as a fixture whose runners were removed) executed the changed actual-driver paths with accepted callback fixtures and ASan/UBSan. It covered 24/26/19.2 MHz clock startup, normalized adoption, preserved direct 24 MHz adoption, PERI0 reserved bit 24, and retained refusal of wrong ratios, lock loss, unstable or disabled oscillator, mismatched APB1 and raw non-24 MHz GPADC input. Cold configuration preserved unrelated fields; adoption performed no GPADC writes; PLL and APB1 registers stayed read-only. Existing conversion, calibration, threshold and controller-service evidence was reused without replay. The second board's preserved OSC=0x983fb0f7 and REF=0xf8675f00 decode 26 MHz with N=96 and M=104, producing normalized 24 MHz; the earlier frozen thermal image refuses this clock profile, and its replacement and exact inputs are retained under the evidence directory. Focused source review accepted source selection, arithmetic and ownership.
